PRODUCING TOGETHER

Human Resources

Discover the way of working at Saniteks, the value of producing together and information on career opportunities.

SHARED EFFORT

Working at Saniteks

Producing together gains meaning when different experiences come together around a common goal. At Saniteks, our people-focused way of working rests on mutual respect, communication and care for the work we do.

An outlook that values sharing information and a sense of responsibility at every stage of production guides our daily work. Listening to one another and learning from experience are core parts of this approach.

GUIDING VALUES

Our Working Culture

We express our view of working and producing together through these complementary values.

  • Cooperation

    Sharing information, listening to one another and contributing together to common goals.

  • Responsibility

    Acting with regard to the effect of the work on the whole process and its surroundings.

  • Continuous development

    Being open to learning new things, drawing on experience and ideas for improvement.

  • Trust

    Valuing working relationships based on mutual understanding, built through open and consistent communication.

  • Quality awareness

    Working carefully and taking care over the work at every stage of production.

  • Equality and respect

    Approaching different experiences and views with respect, and valuing everyone's contribution.

FROM EXPERIENCE TO THE FUTURE

Approach to Development

We see professional and personal development as going hand in hand with being open to new knowledge and reflecting on everyday experience. Asking questions, observing and listening to different perspectives nurture this approach.

Learning together

Sharing experience helps us understand the work better. Thinking together and bringing what we learn into our work is part of an outlook that is open to development.

GENERAL PROCESS FLOW

Recruitment Process

The flow below shows the general stages that may be part of recruitment. The steps followed may vary depending on the position and the assessment needs.

  1. 01

    Application

    Application details are shared through the relevant channel.

  2. 02

    Pre-screening

    Experience and competencies are considered together with the requirements of the position.

  3. 03

    Interview

    Interviews with suitable candidates about mutual expectations.

  4. 04

    Assessment

    The interview and the application details are assessed together.

  5. 05

    Feedback

    Feedback on the status of the assessment is shared.

CAREER OPPORTUNITIES

Open Positions

There are currently no open positions.

For information on application options, see the general application section below.

APPLICATION FORM

Send your application.

You can apply for one of the open positions or submit a general application. When you send the form, your details and CV file are forwarded by e-mail to the relevant team; your file is not stored on the website.

You can also send your application together with your CV by e-mail to ik@sanifoam.com.tr. Questions about the application process can also be sent via the contact form.
